title: Ledger line
description: One decision on one proposed learned edit from /po-retro, accepted or rejected, as in ai-sdlc-loop's ledger of edits (9.12). JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, stored in the products repo at <products repo>/.po/ledger.jsonl (one ledger per client or team, so client evidence never lands in the public aidev-po repo). The latest line for an id is its current state: po appends a full new line when an accepted edit is applied.

retro.description: The retro this came from, retro-<yyyymmdd>-<nn>. Its files are in <products repo>/.po/retro/<retro>/.

scope.description: global: an edit to aidev-po itself, for every run. client: the client's preference profile, <products repo>/.po/preferences.md, never pooled across clients. product: a correction to one product's decisions; recorded for history, not a learning.

surface.description: The one surface the edit changes.

path.description: The source file, for example skills/actor-catalogue/SKILL.md, or .po/preferences.md, or <product>/.po/register.jsonl.

change.description: The edit in a sentence, and the diff file under the retro folder.

cause.description: The cause the edit targets, from attribution.schema.json x-causes.

mechanism.description: The group of failures this edit fixes, in a phrase.

held_in.description: The failing cases the edit was made for (red before, green after).

held_out.description: Cases the proposer never saw: other confirmed feedback cases and the worked example in examples/.

decision.description: The user's decision. Only the user accepts.

decided_by.description: Who decided: always the user, by name if given.

applied.description: null until an accepted edit is applied. For a global edit, the aidev-po branch and commit (and the pull request, if the user opened one).
